summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for April 2026, reporting the results of its Annual General Ordinary/Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting held on April 28, 2026. The meeting approved the integrated annual report, financial statements, management performance, and allocation of retained earnings for fiscal year 2025, including transfers to legal and voluntary reserves. The filing is a routine foreign issuer report of a standard shareholder meeting and does not involve any special-situation corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change.
